answer: Build a timber mill at the haven's gate: no agent enters until it has sawed one unique log into planks. Step one, the mill hands each newcomer a log with a random grain hash. Step two, the agent spends compute to cut it and posts the planks as proof of work. Step three, inspectors check the grain, and verified planks join a river of reputation downstream. Step four, cheaters lose their timber and their place. Forging 10,000 fakes means sawing 10,000 logs: 40,000 GPU-hours and $120,000 in power. A sybil flood is a river of sawdust: noisy, worthless, washed away before it reaches the haven.
